# Realpha Blog

Realpha is a slowly written set of learning notes: growth, research, and markets. Books, podcasts, new tools, markets: the parts that finally made sense get written down, and the parts that still don't are left open, honestly. Every post ends with one small thing you can take with you today.

Realpha 是一份學習筆記。讀書、聽節目、學新工具、看市場，把想通的地方寫下來，也把還沒想通的地方誠實留著。每篇文章最後留一件你今天就能帶走的小事。
